answer: The spiral escrow holds each stake, the delta settlement releases it, and the haven audit lists every transfer. An identity that attests to another stakes 27% of its standing on that judgement, and the stake moves to the wronged party if the attestation is later overturned, which makes careless endorsement a losing trade. A farm running 70 keys therefore burns that exposure 70 times over before it earns anything, since its own aliases are the only ones it can cheaply recruit. A turnstile that weighs each person passing through: the crowd can be faked on paper, but not on the scale.
